title: 读取就近与短路读（short-circuit read）
expected_output:
reader_rack: rack1
block_locations: [('dn1', 'rack1'), ('dn2', 'rack2'), ('dn3', 'rack3')]
chosen_replica: dn1
short_circuit_possible: True
code:
READER_RACK = "rack1"
BLOCK_LOC = {"blkA": [("dn1", "rack1"), ("dn2", "rack2"), ("dn3", "rack3")]}
def pick(reader_rack, locs):
    same = [d for d, r in locs if r == reader_rack]
    return same[0] if same else locs[0][0]
chosen = pick(READER_RACK, BLOCK_LOC["blkA"])
print("reader_rack:", READER_RACK)
print("block_locations:", BLOCK_LOC["blkA"])
print("chosen_replica:", chosen)
print("short_circuit_possible:", chosen == "dn1")
